sfx.bell.toll
sfx.gate.creak
Traveller! The Drowned Bell has been silent since the flood took the old belfry.
Will you help us?

options.text: I'll find the clapper and ring it.

value.text: Bless you. Odd keeps the marsh gate key, and he will want coin for it.
Because the marsh will not let anyone rest until that bell rings again.
You rang it! Hollowmere can sleep again. Take my lantern, you have earned it.
The marsh gate stays shut. Odd has the key.
The gate's open. Watch your step out there.
The gate key? Three old coins, and no haggling.

options.text: Maren sent me. She trusts me.

value.text: Pleasure doing business. Mind the reeds.
For Maren, then. Take it, and do not drown.
...silent... the bell is silent...
The toll... I hear it... I am free.
Did you ever hear the bell? I never have.
Gran says it fell in the marsh, by the dead willow.
ambience.belfry.freed
The belfry falls quiet. Something has left it.
